notes.title: Hollywood Animal is out now on Steam in Early Access! Weappy Sale starts!
notes.content:
Hollywood Animal Early Access is now available on Steam!

The current version of the game offers about 20 in-game years and over 30 hours of gameplay. We plan to release monthly content updates, along with regular fixes and tweaks.

A lot has changed since we released the Christmas demo, so we strongly recommend starting a fresh save.

For the first week, Hollywood Animal will be available at a 10% discount.

[previewyoutube=5ZF3B48_sRY;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680550/Hollywood_Animal/

Weappy Developer Sale

From April 10th to 17th, enjoy discounts of up to 80% on Weappy's games! Grab the latest release, Hollywood Animal, with a 10% discount, along with This Is the Police, This Is the Police 2, and Rebel Cops at up to 80% off.

Additionally, don't miss out on bundles during the sale, including the Weappy Bundle featuring our games and The Jazz Age Bundle, which includes Hollywood Animal and News Tower by our friends at Twin Sails Interactive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31927508/2ca88a5ebee129b8c67412d22a5d5ef99b16db62.png

notes.title: Early Access Release Date, New Demo and Video
notes.content:
In Hollywood Animal, you'll take the lead of your own film studio, and carve out a place for yourself under the bright Californian sun. But it won't be enough to just place buildings, and hire people, and come up with stories to make into films. After all, you're not the only dreamer in this town. And this time, your competitors aren't the background abstractions you might be expecting in this genre. No, these rivals are cunning, insidious, and willing to cross any line. You'll find out about all it – and much more – in the new gameplay video.


[previewyoutube=oDFPTtGHyno;full][/previewyoutube]

Put your skills to the test on January 16, 2025, when Hollywood Animal goes live on Steam Early Access. And in case you want to practice a little, before your full-on clash with the Hollywood heavyweights, we have prepared a new free demo for you, coming in December.

Wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680550/Hollywood_Animal/

- Weappy Wholesome

notes.title: Chinese and Spanish + new exclusive content
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23486552/d6ff6972bc341c4622f1584bf3b688195ff52a5e.png

Hello, guys! We continue to work on making Freeburg a better and more multicultural place. Today we are happy to update This Is the Police with Spanish and Chinese languages! Hooray!

And here comes more. We want to give you guys something special – exclusive criminal gang (3 new investigations) for each new language. People playing Spanish version will be able to hunt down a gang named ‘Ángeles Guardianes’ (these guys for sure don’t have wings!), and for Chinese-speaking players there is ‘骨肉帮’ gang.

Thanks for your patience, have fun! And of course, stay tuned for more!

Update 1.0.49: Just a minor update with some fixes.

 Fixed: all dates were showing as today's date
 Fixes to Spanish and Portuguese text
 Minor fixes to new Chinese gang investigation

notes.title: Jackass Comics and Ultra-Wide (21:9) Support
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23486552/808834ea84888cedd8eaf5a3cdde62fc36e808d7.gif

Good news! Jackass comics is now available for player who finished the game. We also added support for the ultra-wide screens. Here's the full list of changes:

 Jackass: An unlockable comic strip about the life of Jack Boyd before This Is the Police. 
 Support for ultra-wide 21:9 screens
 Changes to promotion UI to make it more obvious that the badge can be interacted with
 Some balance changes to the game
 Deadlines for arrests won't count the skipped days anymore
 Fixed an issue with duplicate SWAT upgrades
 Minor fixes to UI and text

notes.title: Update v1.0.42
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23486552/d3903b88a90fff05b7e8cabf317b7e0d57f244cb.png

We've got some more fixes and improvements to the game. The most important change is for when Jack is arrested we show some explanation on why. Here's the full list of changes:

 When Jack gets arrested, show explanation on why
 Fixed a bug where you could get assignments from Mafia even after eliminated them
 Fixed a lighting issue on the map
 Show a little bit more of the map for 4:3 aspect ratios
 Minor changes and fixes to UI
 Minor corrections to text


We also posted a list of known solutions to some of the issues that come up frequently. If you have issues with the game you might want to check it out:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/443810/discussions/0/343785574512522479/

Edit:
We just found a bug in the Music Catalog and fixed it in the new patch 1.0.43.

notes.title: Consulting Detective
notes.content:
We have a new update with a new feature: Consulting detective is a retired investigator who can help you. Not for free, of course. You can hire him in the deputy services window.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23486552/85af499ff40bea457eb4558578f55e6e4a7da6f3.png

The full list of changes:

 Consulting detective
 Added option to use the system cursor instead of the custom one, to solve the problem some players have on Linux
 Added the launch option to force start the game in DirectX 9 mode that seems to solve crashes on some Windows machines
 Minor bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Update v1.0.27
notes.content:
Here's another update to fix some of the issues players had. As always, if you encounter any problems don't hesitate to report the problem in out forums and we will try our best to fix the issues:
 Bug Reports Discussion Forums 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23486552/02f966caf366267d7f19206d54901928af84d270.png

Chagelog:

 Option disable gamepad input in options menu, also can be disabled by "-disableGamepad" launch option
 Fixed number of frames that are shown for archived investigations
 Possible fix for launching the game on Mac
 Fixed invisible continue button in Mafia Wars results screen
 Disabled aspect ratios over 16:9 until we fix this issue
 Possible fix for failing missions when cops are send on a 0:00 timer
 Fixed a scenario where it was possible to send detectives on 2 different investigations
 Option to disable lens aberration effect
 Fixed duration of a crime
 Some minor performance optimizations
 Minor fixes to text

notes.title: Update v1.0.26
notes.content:

For now We decided to push an update with some fixes:

 Possible fix for switching to gamepad control even when the gamepad is disconnected or when player has a flight joystick
 Increased the deadline for arresting the suspect in investigations
 Gamepad fix in services windows
 Minor fixes to Russian and German text
